Managed a portfolio of 1,800 housing units using digital tools and data analysis

projects.name: CV Tailor
projects.description: Resume generator that tailors a CV to a job description without inventing content. ASP.NET Core monolith (.NET 10) with a Blazor Server UI and a REST API, shipped as one Docker service.
highlights: Rule-based relevance scoring (skills 50%, keywords 30%, seniority 20%) that selects and reorders real experience and never fabricates content
Skill dictionary and job-post parser tuned on a dated corpus of 194 real job posts, reading the posted seniority level correctly in 91% of them
PDF rendering with PuppeteerSharp and DOCX with OpenXML, with page-fit enforcement for one- or two-page CVs
7,500+ automated test cases (unit, API, PDF and DOCX documents) plus Playwright end-to-end tests run in GitHub Actions CI

projects.name: Temple Trips (TT)
projects.description: Multi-tenant church administration platform for units, members, activities, and temple trip registrations, with tenant-aware authorization end to end.
highlights: Tenant-aware query filters and middleware-based authorization: JWT auth, tenant hydration, area active-state validation, and permission checks
Domain services keep controllers thin across units, members, activities, temple trips, users, permissions, and SysAdmin area management
Handles operational edge cases: protected system roles, soft deletes, trip capacity, duplicate registration prevention, and XLSX export of registrations

projects.name: CineApi (Movie App Backend)
projects.description: Production-style REST API for cinema management with role-based authorization and seat reservations, built solo.
highlights: Cookie-based JWT authentication with three roles (Sys Admin, Cinema Admin, Regular User) enforcing fine-grained access policies
Seat reservations with business constraints (at most 4 seats per screening per user), plus movie, screening, and user administration
Layered architecture (Controllers, Services, Data) with EF Core, raw SQL migrations, centralized error handling, and a Dockerized PostgreSQL setup
